hybrid_on_gaps.question: What is the main objective of the design programmes at V-SIGN?
hybrid_on_gaps.answer: The main objective of the V-SIGN programmes is "to create a new breed of problem solvers in the domain of industrial design" [chunk_p3_04]. Additionally, the programmes aim to develop students' skills, knowledge, and aptitude to foster innovation in the product manufacturing industry [chunk_p3_05].

Our programmes aim at developing skills, knowledge and aptitude among students so that they can bring about innovation in the product manufacturing industry.

hybrid_on_gaps.question: How are V-SIGN students trained to approach product design?
hybrid_on_gaps.answer: V-SIGN students are trained to approach product design from a "holistic viewpoint - integrating the aesthetics, ergonomics, and engineering in a balanced and harmonious manner" [chunk_p3_05]. This training is supported by state-of-the-art studio and lab facilities used for teaching, model-making, prototyping, and experimenting [chunk_p3_04].

hybrid_on_gaps.question: What kind of building houses the design facilities at V-SIGN?
hybrid_on_gaps.answer: The design facilities at V-SIGN are housed in a "sprawling new building" [chunk_p3_04]. This building provides space for activities such as teaching, training, model-making, prototyping, and experimenting [chunk_p3_04].

hybrid_on_gaps.question: Why does the document say present-day students need a flexible system?
hybrid_on_gaps.answer: Present day students prefer to make their own decisions and "plan their future by themselves" [chunk_p1_03]. Additionally, a flexible system is necessary because employers expect students to have "multi-disciplinary competency" and "leadership skills," which the system enables by allowing students to "build their own curriculum" while enhancing their "skill in planning" [chunk_p1_03], [chunk_p2_01].

citations.quote: Present day students like to make decisions on their own and like to plan their future by themselves.
Employers expect students to have multi-disciplinary competency, leadership skills, and be Information and Communication Technology (ICT) ready.
9. FFCS offers not only wide choice of courses for students to build their own curriculum, but also enhances their skill in planning.

hybrid_on_gaps.gold: They like to decide and plan their future themselves.

hybrid_on_gaps.question: In a dispute over interpreting the rules, whose interpretation is final and binding?
hybrid_on_gaps.answer: In any dispute regarding the interpretation of the rules, only the interpretation provided by the Academic Council or the Academic Policy Committee is considered final and binding [chunk_p2_07]. The Academic Policy Committee is headed by the Vice-Chancellor of the University [chunk_p2_07].

citations.quote: In case of any dispute arising in interpreting the rules, only the interpretation given by the Academic Council (or) the Academic Policy Committee will be considered as final and binding.

Not withstanding anything mentioned herein, the Academic Council (or) the Academic Policy Committee headed by the Vice-Chancellor of the University has the right to add, delete or modify these regulations time to time.

hybrid_on_gaps.gold: Academic Council or Academic Policy Committee.
